limitations: Baseline was stopped during the third formal request; only the two completed, validated requests are used.
Later optimization rows and the final recheck are retained from v1.41, not newly measured under the refreshed baseline policy.
The first optimization transition has no isolated saved-time claim because its baseline configuration changed.
No matched new Nsight trace exists. Baseline breakdown uses completed request service logs, not estimated GPU kernels.
Two baseline samples and three per retained cohort do not characterize p95 or sustained real-time reliability.
The retained v1.41 cohorts ran in reverse order and may contain time/temperature drift; their final configuration was repeated at the end.
Model, step-count, attention and precision changes are not all lossless.
Exact engineering denotes byte equality on the retained request, not a universal perceptual-quality guarantee.
This standalone case does not measure ASR, LLM, browser playback or rolling history.
